preconditions.description: The number of arguments n is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i in {0, 1} for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each argument a_i is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or starts with 'YES\n(' followed by a valid expression.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NO' if all(a_i == 1 for a_i in a) else True
postconditions.description: The output is 'NO' if all arguments are 1, otherwise it is 'YES'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES\n0' if n == 1 and a[0] == 0 else True
postconditions.description: If there is only one argument and it is 0, the output is 'YES\n0'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES\n(((0)->1)->(1->0))' if n == 4 and a == [0, 1, 1, 0] else True
postconditions.description: For the specific input [0, 1, 1, 0], the output is 'YES\n(((0)->1)->(1->0))'.
